purpose: Make SEIS useful as a public-safe, no-key creative production kit for founders, designers, and small teams that need agency-grade structure without immediately buying a full agency engagement.
notClaims: not a guaranteed replacement for every professional designer
not a live client services marketplace
not a paid media buying system
not a verified customer case study

workflow.title: Client brief intake
workflow.output: A short creative brief with audience, offer, tone, constraints, and required formats.

workflow.title: Client discovery intake
workflow.output: A discovery intake matrix covering decision maker, success metric, existing assets, missing inputs, channel needs, legal blockers, private asset boundary, and next evidence request without claiming client contracts.

workflow.title: Brand and offer naming
workflow.output: A naming decision matrix covering name options, offer phrase, audience fit, pronunciation, memorability, domain and social availability notes, trademark blockers, rejected names, decision owner, and next evidence request without claiming brand-name clearance.

workflow.title: Brand strategy workshop
workflow.output: A stakeholder-ready workshop matrix covering business goal, audience promise, category pressure, must-say and must-not-say rules, proof gaps, unresolved questions, decision owner, and next review action without claiming business strategy guarantees.

workflow.title: Proposal scope estimate
workflow.output: A no-key scope, effort, cut-list, and approval boundary that helps compare agency quotes without making binding pricing claims.

workflow.title: Agency quote comparator
workflow.output: A public-safe comparison between external quote line items and SEIS draft outputs, evidence gaps, risks, exclusions, and review owners without claiming guaranteed savings.

workflow.title: Agency cost control matrix
workflow.output: A cost-control matrix that maps agency line items to SEIS in-house routes, external-buy triggers, quality risks, evidence requirements, decision owners, and approval gates without claiming procurement advice or guaranteed savings.

workflow.title: Design sprint timeline
workflow.output: A sprint timeline matrix that maps discovery, strategy freeze, production blocks, review checkpoints, revision windows, QA, approval, handoff, owner, blocker rules, and validation evidence without claiming delivery date guarantees.

workflow.title: Competitive positioning matrix
workflow.output: A competitor-set and visual-territory matrix covering category cues, differentiation claim, whitespace opportunity, evidence gaps, risks, and decision owner without claiming market research.

workflow.title: Brand voice and messaging matrix
workflow.output: A voice and messaging matrix covering tagline options, message hierarchy, tone rules, proof points, CTA language, channel adaptations, claim risk, and copy review owner without claiming legal copy approval.

workflow.title: Typography pairing and hierarchy
workflow.output: A typography direction matrix covering display, text, UI, mono, fallback roles, scale, contrast, readability, language support, font license blocker, and implementation owner without claiming font licensing.

workflow.title: Color system accessibility matrix
workflow.output: A color-system matrix covering palette roles, contrast pairs, dark-mode behavior, status color labeling, token mapping, accessibility risk, and review owner without claiming accessibility certification.

workflow.title: Print production readiness
workflow.output: A print-readiness matrix covering trim, bleed, safe zone, color mode, resolution, export format, paper/vendor notes, proof status, and review owner without claiming print proof approval.

workflow.title: Brand rationale deck
workflow.output: A design decision narrative covering audience, offer, hierarchy, proof, token choices, objections, tradeoffs, and next review action without claiming guaranteed persuasion.

workflow.title: Visual reference moodboard
workflow.output: A reference direction board covering themes, color mood, type attitude, imagery cues, motion tone, provenance notes, rejected directions, and review owner without claiming licensed asset approval.

workflow.title: Creative asset shot list
workflow.output: A shot-list matrix covering scene, composition, crop, lighting, prop, format, motion need, provenance status, release risk, and production owner without claiming model release approval.

workflow.title: Logo concept evaluation
workflow.output: A logo direction matrix covering concept options, mark style, wordmark fit, small-size readability, monochrome use, misuse risk, trademark review blocker, and decision owner without claiming final logo approval.

workflow.title: Identity direction
workflow.output: Color, type, spacing, logo-direction, icon, and usage notes connected to SEIS tokens.

workflow.title: Brand usage guideline
workflow.output: A logo, color, type, imagery, do/don't, accessibility, misuse, and escalation guide for using SEIS brand assets without claiming trademark licensing or legal clearance.

workflow.title: Landing and portfolio surface
workflow.output: A no-key landing/page composition path using existing SEIS web routes and design QA.

workflow.title: Landing page blueprint
workflow.output: A landing-page blueprint matrix covering hero promise, section order, proof blocks, objections, CTA ladder, responsive priority, accessibility notes, analytics questions, owner, and no-conversion-guarantee boundary.

workflow.title: Case study layout
workflow.output: A context, challenge, response, proof, accessibility, quality path, CTA, and handoff structure for portfolio storytelling without claiming verified customer results.

workflow.title: Campaign and social kit
workflow.output: A repeatable post/ad/story/presentation brief structure with safe copy and visual direction.

workflow.title: Creative director QA
workflow.output: A no-key review scorecard for clarity, hierarchy, contrast, consistency, motion restraint, provenance, and publication readiness.

workflow.title: Revision round plan
workflow.output: A two-round decision and polish plan that avoids endless revision loops and keeps client handoff reviewable.

workflow.title: Client feedback triage
workflow.output: A comment intake and triage board that separates decision fixes, polish, out-of-scope requests, accessibility risk, blocked evidence, owner, and next review action without claiming stakeholder consensus.

workflow.title: Visual QA evidence ledger
workflow.output: A screenshot, viewport, accessibility, reviewer-decision, blocker, and validation-command ledger for design review evidence without fabricating unavailable proof.

workflow.title: Client approval packet
workflow.output: A decision packet with included assets, exclusions, known risks, approval owner, and next-round boundary before client delivery.

workflow.title: Client-ready export index
workflow.output: A delivery index of included outputs, source paths, review state, blockers, exclusions, validation commands, rollback notes, and owners without claiming downloadable archive delivery.

workflow.title: Asset provenance review
workflow.output: A source, license, transformation, and approval record for every external image/video/font.

workflow.title: Client handoff pack
workflow.output: A compact handoff with source paths, validation commands, accessibility notes, and next actions.
